verdict.rationale: The pack shows no documented account- or company-level analysis for funnels, retention, or trends. The only mention of "group" is in feature-flag rollout targeting, which is a different capability. SQL joins against synced Salesforce/HubSpot data are a building block a user could use to construct account rollups, not the capability itself, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can analyze behavior at the account or company level, not just per user, for B2B products
